name: Teacher Contact
description: A teacher contact can be represented in phone content as a school-related line of communication, but each student must manage how much access they actually have to it.

name: Parent Contact
description: Family contacts keep home life close and visible, especially in schools where parent relationship and discipline are important.

name: Friend Contact
description: Friend group chats and repeated contact structure daily student privacy and social rhythm.

name: Default Ringtone
description: Even a small default tone matters to school life because the sound of a phone is a social and disciplinary signal.

name: Message Notification
description: Notifications represent the tension between hidden communication and school rules, especially when students are trying to stay discreet.

name: School Mode
description: A simple profile or school-mode concept can reflect the pressure of being constantly reachable while technically restricted.
